comments.body: Just for your information, a company colony with fancy trade goods like colored ores can be obtained via immigration attraction points, however.. the points are never permanent. comments.author: CaliCaddy
comments.body: Do you need colored ores? An Amsterdam company ACME_Corporation colony in New France is offering Red Ore Blue Ore Green Ore Yellow Ore White Ore in large quantities, make sure to bring a toon with high Mineral Trading and perhaps a Alchemist Robe EX to take maximum advantage of the output. You can register the colony using "Improved_rope" toon that usually bazaars in Seville between the company office and the fountain.
